Indicative route-planner times[9]
TALENT AND ECOSYSTEM
■ ESAD.CR — School of Arts and Design: around 1,600 students and over 130 faculty[10]; named by Domus 
magazine (2019) among Europe’s top 100 design schools.
■ LiDA — design and arts research lab, rated «Excellent» by FCT [11]. Co-developed with Santos Barosa  
(Vidrala) a 260 g 75 cl wine bottle under the «Packaging of the Future» agenda (79 partners) [12], winning 
two Red Dot awards in 2026[13].
■ University of Leiria and Oeste — established in July 2026 [14]; its new Health campus in Caldas opened  
on 6 October with around 80 students in four higher technical programmes (Thermalism and Wellbeing;  
Aesthetics, Cosmetics and Wellbeing; Forensic Laboratory; Healthy Eating) and two degrees under  
accreditation[15].
■ CENCAL · CENFIM — vocational training for ceramics and glass[16] and for metalworking, with a centre in 
Caldas[17].
■ UPCaldas  — incubator opened on 12 June  2026:  14  private  offices,  20  coworking  desks  and  an  
auditorium[18]. Over 20 years, AIRO’s incubation programme has supported more than 2,000 entrepreneurs 
and 780 projects[19]; the A8 Innovation Corridor links incubators in Leiria, Caldas, Óbidos and Loures[20].
■ Creative communities — Prontos and SILOS attract freelancers and small studios who chose to live 
and work here.

INSTRUMENT WHAT APPLIES SOURCE

least 3 jobs created and kept
[21]

IRS 3% returned to residents [22]
Portugal 2030 Incentives for innovation, R&D and skills: eligibility depends on the 
call, activity code, expenditure and timing
[23][24]
TIP FOR YOUR BUSINESS CASE
Exemptions require formal recognition and must meet the regulation’s conditions. Send us your activity code, 
investment breakdown, jobs and start date and we will screen the support options with you.
LIVING HERE
Parque D. Carlos I steps from the centre, the Óbidos lagoon and Foz do Arelho beach about 15 minutes away, 
a street market five centuries old, ceramics, jazz and design everywhere. Schools, a hospital centre and a  
lively cultural scene make Caldas a place where teams want to stay. To prepare your team’s move, tell us  
what you need (housing, schools, healthcare) and we will connect you with the right people.
LET’S TALK
Via Expresso · Caldas da Rainha City Council
economia@mcr.pt  ·  +351 262 240 000
Tell us your activity, space, investment, jobs and timetable. We will walk the rest of the way with you.

The municipal survey supplied on 19 October 2026 reports approximately 400 ha of industrial land in the 
current PDM and 586 ha in the proposed revision (+186 ha; approximately +46%). The proposal is subject 
to approval and these areas are not available plots. See the Asset Map and industrial-area sheets for the 
breakdown and data limitations.
